item.title: Version 1.6.2
item.changes: New Reduce Noise filter and adjustment layer, which smooths grain while keeping edges and texture Camera Raw's Luminance noise reduction keeps much more detail Panning and zooming performance improved over Reduce Noise and Lens Effects layers The layers panel has separate buttons for non-destructive adjustment layers and filter layers The layers panel's buttons are easier to click, and their menus open above them Adjustment layer panels no longer have a Preview checkbox; use the layer's eye to compare Levels panel UI polish The app window opens full width and height after an update
